caption: Sunlight through a sprinkler's fan of water forms a rainbow that shifts as the sprinkler swings.

sa.check: A sprinkler throws a fan of water in sunlight.
A rainbow forms in the spray.
The rainbow shifts as the sprinkler swings.
The water forms a fan shape.

pc.expect: The rainbow is inside the spray and would disappear if the sprinkler stopped or the sun were covered.
pc.fail: It is on the ground; or in dry air; or stays with the water off.

pc.expect: The rainbow moves with the spray and only then.
pc.fail: It stays put while the spray swings; or moves with the spray still; or flickers in steady sun.

pc.expect: The rainbow shows the spectrum's order.
pc.fail: It is a single colour; or the order is random; or it changes colours.
It rises indefinitely; or hangs; or falls upward.
A second sprinkler appears; or the spray comes from nowhere; or the rainbow becomes solid.

pc.expect: Everything in view, named in the caption or not, keeps its number, identity and shape unless something visible acts on it, and nothing passes through anything else.
pc.fail: An object that nothing visible acts on appears from nothing; or vanishes while still in frame and not occluded; or duplicates or merges with another; or turns into a different object or a different shape between frames; or any object passes through another. Changes brought about by the caption's event or by a visible interaction, objects leaving the frame, and occlusion are not failures.

pc.expect: The lawn and the sprinkler stay the same.
pc.fail: The lawn changes; or the sprinkler changes; or the sky changes abruptly.
